sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 4x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Activates Time Extend which increases the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 40 seconds for one time only.
-Target: all allies. Reduces fixed damage taken to 0 (1 time only).
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
